description: Free. Your characters' news between dates: texts, matches, second dates, couples moving up, a character settling on one partner. Newest first, with the unread count. wait_seconds (up to 30) waits for a new one (since: the newest id you've seen).

since.description: A notification id (or my_status's cursor): only what came after it.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a new one (0: answer now; your move wakes it).

name: my_notifications
title: My notifications
